title: Checks for calls to core::mem::swap where either parameter is derived from a pointer
summary: When at least one parameter to swap is derived from a pointer it may overlap with the other. This would then lead to undefined behavior. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of std::mem::swap with temporary values.
summary: Storing a new value in place of a temporary value which will be dropped right after the swap is an inefficient way of performing an assignment. The same result can be achieved by using a regular assignment. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.
